summary: Add duplicate alert suppression window for POST /api/alerts by reusing a recent active alert with matching title and severity.

acceptance_criteria.text: On POST /api/alerts, if an active alert with the same Title (case-insensitive) and Severity was created within the configured suppression window, do not create a new row and instead return the existing alert payload.
When a duplicate is suppressed, the API returns 200 OK and includes response header X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true.
When no duplicate is found, POST /api/alerts continues to create a new alert and returns 201 Created.
Suppression window minutes are configurable via appsettings.json and are not hardcoded.
Suppression does not apply across different severities and does not apply when prior matching alerts are inactive.

constraints: No duplicate row creation when suppression condition is met.
Duplicate matching is case-insensitive on Title and exact on Severity.
Only active alerts are candidates for suppression.
Suppression applies only within configured minute window.
Controller response contract must distinguish suppressed (200 + header) vs created (201).
Do not change behavior of unrelated endpoints.
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage for AC1-AC5 across controller status/header behavior, service suppression branching, and repository duplicate candidate lookup semantics.
